frames.narrative_action: Tom spots Jerry raiding the icebox.
frames.visual_action: Wide shot of the kitchen. Tom is in the foreground, eyes wide with surprise. Jerry is at the icebox, back to the camera, munching on cheese. The kitchen is bright with gleaming white tiles and dramatic shadows from hanging pots.
frames.action_breakdown: Wide shot of the kitchen. Tom is in the foreground, eyes wide with surprise. Jerry is at the icebox, back to the camera, munching on cheese. The kitchen is bright with gleaming white tiles and dramatic shadows from hanging pots.
frames.lighting_notes: Bright overhead lights, dramatic shadows from hanging pots
frames.purpose: Establish the setting and the initial surprise of Tom spotting Jerry
frames.director_notes: Set the stage for the chase and the slapstick humor

frames.narrative_action: Tom creeps forward with a rolling pin.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of Tom creeping forward, rolling pin raised. Jerry is still at the icebox, oblivious. The camera follows Tom's movement, slightly tilted to show his sneaky approach.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of Tom creeping forward, rolling pin raised. Jerry is still at the icebox, oblivious. The camera follows Tom's movement, slightly tilted to show his sneaky approach.
frames.lighting_notes: Bright overhead lights, shadows cast by Tom's movement
frames.purpose: Build tension as Tom tries to sneak up on Jerry
frames.director_notes: Show Tom's stealthy approach to heighten the comedy

frames.narrative_action: Jerry doesn't look up. He finishes his cheese wedge.
frames.visual_action: Over-the-shoulder shot of Jerry, finishing his cheese. Tom is in the background, still creeping. The camera is positioned over Tom's shoulder, showing Jerry's obliviousness.
frames.action_breakdown: Over-the-shoulder shot of Jerry, finishing his cheese. Tom is in the background, still creeping. The camera is positioned over Tom's shoulder, showing Jerry's obliviousness.
frames.lighting_notes: Bright overhead lights, shadows from hanging pots
frames.purpose: Show Jerry's obliviousness to Tom's approach
frames.director_notes: Highlight Jerry's calm demeanor despite the impending danger

frames.narrative_action: Jerry points behind Tom.
frames.visual_action: Close-up of Jerry's hand pointing behind Tom. Tom turns to look, confusion on his face. The camera is low, emphasizing Jerry's trickery.
frames.action_breakdown: Close-up of Jerry's hand pointing behind Tom. Tom turns to look, confusion on his face. The camera is low, emphasizing Jerry's trickery.
frames.lighting_notes: Bright overhead lights, shadows from hanging pots
frames.purpose: Highlight the moment of deception
frames.director_notes: Capture the moment of Jerry's trickery

frames.narrative_action: Tom turns. Nothing there. When he turns back, Jerry is gone.
frames.visual_action: Wide shot of the kitchen. Tom turns to look behind him, then back to where Jerry was. Jerry is gone. The camera pans to show the empty space where Jerry was.
frames.action_breakdown: Wide shot of the kitchen. Tom turns to look behind him, then back to where Jerry was. Jerry is gone. The camera pans to show the empty space where Jerry was.
frames.lighting_notes: Bright overhead lights, dramatic shadows from hanging pots
frames.purpose: Show the sudden disappearance of Jerry
frames.director_notes: Highlight the sudden disappearance to build tension

frames.narrative_action: Tom is hit in the face with his own rolling pin — from nowhere.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of Tom getting hit in the face with the rolling pin. The camera is positioned to show the rolling pin flying in from the side. Tom's expression is one of shock and pain.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of Tom getting hit in the face with the rolling pin. The camera is positioned to show the rolling pin flying in from the side. Tom's expression is one of shock and pain.
frames.lighting_notes: Bright overhead lights, shadows from hanging pots
frames.purpose: Capture the moment of impact
frames.director_notes: Show the slapstick humor of Tom getting hit
frames.sound_cue: Sound of rolling pin hitting Tom

frames.narrative_action: Tom sprints after Jerry across the waxed hardwood floor.
frames.visual_action: Establishing wide shot of the hallway. Tom is sprinting, Jerry is calmly stepping aside. The hallway is long and bright with soft chandelier light and dramatic shadows.
frames.action_breakdown: Establishing wide shot of the hallway. Tom is sprinting, Jerry is calmly stepping aside. The hallway is long and bright with soft chandelier light and dramatic shadows.
frames.lighting_notes: Soft chandelier light, dramatic shadows from chandelier
frames.purpose: Establish the setting and the chase
frames.director_notes: Set the stage for the chase sequence

frames.narrative_action: He cannot stop. He slides the full length of the hall.
frames.visual_action: Tracking shot following Tom as he slides across the floor. The camera moves smoothly, capturing the full length of the hallway. Tom's expression is one of panic and surprise.
frames.action_breakdown: Tracking shot following Tom as he slides across the floor. The camera moves smoothly, capturing the full length of the hallway. Tom's expression is one of panic and surprise.
